author: smimon
text:
Good trading pal. Some of those are unconfirmed trades - you just going off PA around the zones? Lose many like this (if you don't mind me asking)?

I resolved last week to try take nothing but confirmed trades from now on (unless I'm already well clear of my profit target for the day, then I don't mind SAS style) - I was hitting some awesome winners, but losing a load too, and I can't cope with going live in those sort of circumstances. 16 trades now since I lost one - some of those are b/e, but that was something I also needed to improve on - reading when price wasn't going the right way off my entry, because I'd read something wrong, and getting out without a loss.

By the way - 23 pip spread on GU? I guess you're not on an ECN broker? It's about 3 or 4 pips usually on mine - it makes all the difference for getting in tight and being able to take quick profit.

Cheers
